provenance.notes: Starting decks and hero-specific replacements from upstream heroes.rs. Four base-game heroes confirmed by MKUE Walkthrough p.5; Wolfhawk/Krang/Braevalar are expansion heroes (Krang and Braevalar are named in reference/extracted/MKUE_expansions_rulebook.txt; Wolfhawk expansion attribution is community knowledge, UNVERIFIED in our extracted sources).

items.name: Arythea
items.starting_crystals_note: Upstream heroes.rs; the official rulebooks do not enumerate every hero's three dummy-player crystal dots, so this is UNVERIFIED.
items.official_cross_check: MKUE Walkthrough p.5: 'There are four Heroes in the game'; p.3/MKUE Rulebook: each starting deck is 16 Basic Action cards; p.15: dummy player starts with three crystals matching the hero card dots (Goldyx example).
